matches.rationale: No finding addresses the fabricated or unspecified D4RL dataset variants ('antmaze-large-diverse', 'maze2d-large') in the recommended-datasets section.
No finding mentions the asymmetric online tuning budgets or the lack of control/reporting for hyperparameter search budgets in the evaluation protocol.

Finding 4 identifies the same inconsistency in the unified actor loss between Section 4.2 and Appendix I.2, specifically that diversity and dynamics/model-based terms are omitted from the appendix definition. This matches the ground-truth issue of omitted critic diversity/model-based regularization terms in the unified actor objective.

No finding addresses missing hardware configurations, parallelization strategies, or compilation/caching details in the speed-up report. The speedup-related finding concerns false numerical claims in the abstract, not reproducibility details.

No finding discusses omitted error bars, selective exclusion of datasets, or unmentioned failures/limitations in the TD3-AWR and MoBRAC results. Finding 3 is a different text-figure contradiction about a specific dataset.
No finding addresses the overbroad conclusion claiming Unifloral achieves superior performance over a wide range of tasks beyond what the limited benchmark evidence supports.
No finding discusses the omission of ethical issues or safety risks in the Introduction.
No finding addresses fabricated or misattributed background citations in Related Work such as [25], [26], [27], or the JAX-CORL characterization.

Finding 1 concerns false quantitative speedup numbers in the abstract, whereas the ground truth is about inflated rhetorical language and lack of qualification. These are related to speedups but identify different scientific issues: factual inconsistency vs. promotional tone.
No finding addresses the contradiction between Unifloral excluding CQL in Section 4.2 and Appendix A.1 including CQL as part of the implemented/reimplemented family.
No finding discusses the pseudocode inconsistency in EDAC's actor update regarding mean vs. min Q-value aggregation or diversity-regularization treatment.
No finding addresses misleading y-axis scaling or tightly ranged axes in the figures that exaggerate performance differences.
No finding discusses missing conflict-of-interest disclosures or funding-transparency concerns in the Acknowledgements.
No finding addresses the inconsistency between the four-variant taxonomy and the evaluation procedure focusing solely on pre-deployment tuning.
No finding addresses over-interpretation of the distractor-policy phenomenon or the treatment of temporary performance dips as evaluation flaws rather than statistical noise.
